note: EVIDENCE: Deezer album and track lists, Apple catalogue lookups (composerTerm searches, album lookups with label and copyright), MusicBrainz work lists (Carter, Crumb, Feldman, Sessions, Babbitt; the MusicBrainz service was blocking most of the run and the lists for the other composers were not fetched), Wikipedia work lists. The IMSLP pages were not opened individually; years, scorings and timings of the IMSLP candidates come from the census input and from the recordings. Naxos Library and Presto were not used. Publisher pages (Peters, Boosey, Presser) were not opened; no `published` field is filled. OWNER MAY RULE: (1) Vocal works: Crumb's Madrigals Book I and Shapey's Songs of Life (voice with two instruments) are left out as vocal repertoire; works with a voice and four or more instruments are kept (Crumb, Carter's Tempo e Tempi, Feldman's For Franz Kline and Intervals). (2) Feldman and Cage works whose scoring comes from the Wikipedia work list only (Projection 5 with nine players, Samoa, Intervals, Trio) are kept at medium or low confidence. (3) Crumb's Dream Sequence counts its off-stage glass harmonica (two players) as celesta, per the house rule. (4) Cowell's HC 802 is scored for harpsichord on IMSLP; the only recording uses harp. (5) Violin catalogue cross-list: only Feldman's Violin and String Quartet (id 4435); ids 426, 595, 1455 and other duos or solos are not in scope, ids 4595 and 4998 have more than nine players. NOT FOUND OR NOT CHECKED: Cage's Four (string quartet, 1989) and Seven2 were not found on a recording; Feldman's Four Instruments (two versions), I Met Heine, The O'Hara Songs, Rabbi Akiba and Vertical Thoughts 5 have scorings or recordings that could not be matched; Hovhaness's quartets Nos. 5 and the flute/oboe/cello/harpsichord quartets were not found recorded; Kirchner's Trio No. 2 year is unconfirmed (left blank).
